finding: A maintainer who creates a symlink to a Factory orientation file may see setup change its target. Both handbook rows promise to keep a symlink the maintainer set up. The installer classifies the symlink by its target in _is_factory_orientation_link and can retarget it in _link_orientation. In a scratch project, setup retargeted a manually created AGENTS.md symlink from config/AGENTS.codex.md to config/AGENTS.md. Describe the distinction using the target that setup recognizes.
why_this_severity: The root orientation rule still covers the symlink (no to fails_purpose). A maintainer must consult the installer to explain why setup changed the target.
